summary: Serve the published agents roster even when a refresh is slow, and stop summary reads folding the roster

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Agents reads keep serving the newest published roster, with its cut and published_at, when a refresh request has gone unanswered for 30 seconds; the daemon logs a warning instead of answering not-ready. Summary reads count agents from the published roster instead of folding it behind the roster admission.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.
